_comment: Mechanic sweep catalogue (placeholders: $weakest_support / $weakest_support2 = the main link supports measured as worth least; $set_eater / $set_exarch set an eldritch implicit on a rare, replacing the item's current one; $capped_element = the element with the most spare resistance, Chaos on a chaos-immune character; $free_slot = an armour slot with a free socket for a utility gem; $weakest_flask = the flask slot the audit found without measured benefit or other effect; unless_flag / requires_unreserved_mana_below are skip rules) for `pob.py sweep`: standard damage/defence mechanics a build may be missing, each with its cheapest source. 'applies' is matched against the build profile (PoB skill flags: attack, spell, melee, hit, dot, minion, crit) and the build's current state. Each entry becomes a compare variant; the sweep classifies results and skips sources whose attribute requirement the build cannot meet (reported, never pursued). Charge entries only run when the matching use*Charges option is off: the driver sets it before the fill when the spec already holds a sustaining source (gem, item, passive, ascendancy), so the sweep only proposes NEW sources.

mechanics.name: Rage (Rage Support in the main link, 30 rage assumed)
mechanics.note: Rage Support grants rage on melee hit (sustaining). 30 is conservative; Berserk raises the cap but spends it.

mechanics.name: Berserk (replaces the guard skill; needs a rage source)
mechanics.note: Strength gem: skipped automatically when the build can't meet its requirement.

mechanics.name: Frenzy charges via Mark Mastery (10% on hit vs marked) if no sustaining source
mechanics.note: Needs a Mark notable allocated (Mark the Prey) and a mark on the enemy (Deathmarked, a mark gem).

mechanics.name: Onslaught (Silver Flask already equipped: config on)
mechanics.note: PoB counts flasks as always up; the audit's flask line applies.

mechanics.name: Onslaught via a Silver Flask (replaces the flask the audit found least useful)

items.text:
Rarity: MAGIC
Experimenter's Silver Flask of the Dove
Silver Flask
Item Level: 84
Quality: 20
38% increased Duration
Grants Immunity to Bleeding for 12 seconds if used while Bleeding
Grants Immunity to Corrupted Blood for 12 seconds if used while affected by Corrupted Blood

mechanics.note: Onslaught Support no longer exists (renamed Momentum, a different mechanic); a Silver Flask is the standard source. PoB counts flasks as always up; the audit's flask line applies.

mechanics.name: Intimidate via Intimidating Cry (utility group)
mechanics.note: Warcry: Strength gem; skipped automatically if the build can't meet it. Needs a socket.

mechanics.name: Exposure on hit (Eater gloves implicit for the main damage type)

items.$set_eater: Inflict $main_element Exposure on Hit, applying -16% to $main_element Resistance

mechanics.note: Replaces the gloves' current Eater implicit, if any. For a random-element skill only one element benefits.

mechanics.name: Phys taken as element (Eater body armour implicit, 12%, element with the most spare resistance)

items.$set_eater: 12% of Physical Damage from Hits taken as $capped_element Damage

mechanics.note: Defensive: raises the phys max hit and PoB EHP; replaces the body's current Eater implicit (often +res, which the over-cap column shows is or isn't spare). Not for unique or corrupted bodies.

mechanics.name: Phys taken as element (Eater helmet implicit, 8%, element with the most spare resistance)

items.$set_eater: 8% of Physical Damage from Hits taken as $capped_element Damage

mechanics.note: Defensive; replaces the helmet's current Eater implicit (often attack/spell damage, so compare shows the DPS cost). Not for unique or corrupted helmets.

mechanics.name: Precision at level 20 (if present at a lower level)
mechanics.note: Costs mana reservation; compare shows whether the crit and accuracy are worth it.

mechanics.name: Power charges via Assassin's Mark (utility group) if no sustaining source
mechanics.note: Works for spells and attacks alike. The charge itself is on kill: honest for mapping, optimistic for a single boss; the audit's evidence line says so.

mechanics.name: Power charges via Power Charge On Critical Support (main link) if no sustaining source
mechanics.note: Replaces the weakest measured support, so compare shows the net effect of trading a damage support for charges plus their crit. On-hit: sustaining against a boss.

mechanics.name: Endurance charges via Enduring Cry (utility group) if no sustaining source
mechanics.note: Warcry: Strength gem; skipped automatically if the build can't meet it. Defensive: compare shows the phys max hit and EHP change. Needs a socket.

mechanics.name: Endurance charges via Endurance Charge on Melee Stun Support (main link) if no sustaining source
mechanics.note: Only sustaining when the build stuns regularly; bosses resist stuns, so read it as a mapping option.

mechanics.name: Frenzy charges via Blood Rage (utility group; on kill, mapping only)
mechanics.note: On-kill source: the build's inference pass never sets useFrenzyCharges from it. Present as a mapping-only gain; the attack speed and leech are real either way.

mechanics.name: Mine delivery (High-Impact Mine + Minefield replace the two weakest supports; 10 mines detonated recently)
mechanics.note: Mines are the budget damage multiplier for self-cast spells (High-Impact Mine aura: 2% more damage per mine detonated recently, Minefield throws 4): the usual +100-300% at the cost of throw-and-detonate gameplay (Detonate Mines on Automation or left click). Charged Mines / Trap and Mine Damage / Swift Assembly follow if accepted; the 10-mine count is the aura's cap, honest only while chain-detonating.

mechanics.name: Unnerve on hit (Exarch gloves implicit: enemies take 10% increased spell damage)

items.$set_exarch: 40% chance to Unnerve Enemies for 4 seconds on Hit

mechanics.note: Replaces the gloves' current Exarch implicit, if any. A spell that hits applies it itself; a pure DoT spell needs another hit source (Frostblink, a mine).

mechanics.name: Intimidate on hit (Exarch gloves implicit: enemies take 10% increased attack damage)

items.$set_exarch: 40% chance to Intimidate Enemies for 4 seconds on Hit

mechanics.note: Replaces the gloves' current Exarch implicit, if any; the cheaper route to Intimidate than a Strength warcry on a non-Strength class.

mechanics.name: Mana Reservation Efficiency (Exarch helmet implicit) when reservations are tight

items.$set_eater: 8% increased Mana Reservation Efficiency of Skills

mechanics.note: Replaces the helmet's current Eater implicit. Measured by itself it changes little; its value is the aura or herald it lets you add next (test that with a second compare).

mechanics.name: Culling Strike (Culling Strike Support in a utility group with the movement skill)
mechanics.note: PoB adds culling to the DPS estimate; cheap if a socket is free.
